result.summary: The pedestrian environment features narrow sidewalks on both sides of a residential street, but lacks basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The presence of parked cars near the intersection and degraded pavement surfaces further reduce safety and accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street lined with row houses and parked vehicles on both sides. While the narrow roadway width may naturally limit vehicle speeds, the environment lacks formal pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, traffic control signs, or curb extensions to improve visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous street parking up to the intersection corners limits sightlines between pedestrians attempting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible at the intersection, creating ambiguity regarding right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks fails to designate a clear path for pedestrians or alert drivers to potential crossing activity.
hazards.location_in_image: The intersection area in the foreground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
